source.text: ውእተ፡ ጊዜ፡ ባረክዎ፡ ለ*እግዚአ፡ ስብሐት፡ ወእቤ፡ ቡሩክ፡ እግዚአየ፡ እግዚአ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ዘይመልክ፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም።

translation.text: At that time I blessed the Lord of Glory and said, “Blessed is my Lord, the Lord of righteousness, who reigns forever.”
